title: José Ferreira
text:
My name is José Ferreira and this is my website. In it, you will find everything that I think is relevant for me to share with the world. If you would like to know more about me, you can have a look at my short CV. My publications are up-to-date in InspireHEP and my code is made available on Github. To contact me, feel free to drop me an e-mail.
